content.text:
I traced the history of `AbstractFile.java`'s `onModification`/`validatePath`/`validatePathUniqueness` logic:

1. Originally (commit `daac41f335`), the `validatePathUniqueness` flag check lived **inside** `validatePath()`, so both `onCreation` and `onModification` (which both just called `validatePath()`) correctly respected the flag.
2. Commit **`ccf0a97dc904c20f2fbf2df3a401e610fb0f761a`** (same author, `kai.schwaiger@structr.com`, 8 days before the fix) refactored `onCreation` to use a new `validateAndRenameFileOnce()` method, guarded by `if (validatePathUniqueness)`. As part of this refactor, it **removed the `validatePathUniqueness` check from inside `validatePath()` itself** (moving the responsibility to the caller) — but only updated the `onCreation` call site to re-add the guard. `onModification` was left unchanged, still calling `validatePath()` unconditionally. Since `validatePath()` no longer contained the flag check, `onModification` now always enforced path-uniqueness validation regardless of the `validatePathUniqueness` config setting — the exact bug fixed in `cdaa42c57`.
3. The fix commit simply restores the missing guard around the `onModification` call site (`if (validatePathUniqueness) { valid = validatePath(...); }`), mirroring what `onCreation` already had — confirming `onModification` was the one spot the Feb 20 refactor forgot to update.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: ccf0a97dc904c20f2fbf2df3a401e610fb0f761a

## Reasoning
(1) I followed the file history of `AbstractFile.java`, grepping for `onModification`/`validatePathUniqueness` across all commits touching it, then diffed the relevant commits in full.
(2) Commit `ccf0a97dc9` removed the `validatePathUniqueness` flag check from inside `validatePath()` (moving it to a new `validateAndRenameFileOnce()` helper used only by `onCreation`), but did not add an equivalent guard to `onModification`, which still calls `validatePath()` directly. This made path-uniqueness validation unconditionally run on modification even when `validatePathUniqueness` is configured `false`.
(3) This is directly confirmed by the diff of `cdaa42c57` (the fix), which re-adds exactly the guard (`if (validatePathUniqueness) { valid = validatePath(...); }`) around the `onModification` call — mirroring the pattern `onCreation` already received in `ccf0a97dc9`. Both commits are authored by the same person (`kai.schwaiger@structr.com`), consistent with the author fixing their own regression ~8 days later. I'm highly confident in this identification.
